name: Fired await delivery-intent cutover mutation probe
command: --test 'cd packages/operator-core && npx vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts lib/events/await/store.integration.test.ts -t "does NOT resurrect a historical fired await without a delivery-intent marker" --reporter=dot'
summary: The real-PostgreSQL historical-row guard passed with the explicit delivery-intent marker. Removing its marker predicate made the reconciler resurrect an old row, so the probe reported MUTANT CAUGHT. The source was restored byte for byte.

assertions.evidence: Focused Vitest baseline: 1 passed, 76 skipped, exit 0.

Removing the fired_delivery_intent_at predicate caused the real-PG test to fail at store.integration.test.ts:425: expected only one recent marked delivery, received two including the unmarked historical row. Guard exit 1.
mutation-probe.sh reported verdict=caught, target=in-tree:lock-held, baseline_exit=0, guard_exit=1, and tree integrity VERIFIED for store.ts.
